title: Wicked Nugget Pack (20 Nuggets + Chips) for $12.95 Pickup @ KFC (App/Online Order Only)
body:
Deal: Wicked Nugget Pack (20 Nuggets + Chips) for $12.95 Pickup @ KFC (App/Online Order Only)

[NotReallyaMoneySaver] Not as good as the $10 for 30 but not half bad
[browser] This is like $10 for 30, but 10 nuggets swapped for chips, and $2.95 for the sauce.
[Yummy] Three bucks sauce tub
Rather just get a bottle sauce from supermarket.
[Fredfloresjr] Then give us better? At least 21 nuggets + chips for $12.95
[AusDaniel] I think this was posted when it had said 12 nuggets
[SeanConnery] You are correct sir. Even at 20 nuggets, its still terrible IMO.
[freoleo] Title says 12 nuggets
Body says 20
Which is right
[Buttershoes] I'm going with telling myself there is 12, but 20 will be in my body.
[witheredcouch] I thought this would be "wicked" nuggets, not just a sauce.
[solys] I was excited as well - very keen to try "wicked nuggets"
[MountainManeuver] Would be awesome! When I first read the title in my email. I thought half both wings and nuggets why? 🤷‍♂️
[Munki] I don't think I've ever had a crispy KFC nugget. Always the consistency of a wet cardboard.
[Mjk698] Yep not sure if they cook them in the microwave 😜 maccas are always crispy but so expensive
[RolloTomasi] Crazy considering all it takes is a minute extra in the fryer.
[tdw] I have. Not too many times, sure, but when I did it was orgasmic. I scoffed like half the box and I didn't even need sauce
[YeemaiI] Their chips too, always soggy and unseasoned.
[korda] It's like I have to cook them a little more in the air fryer to try and get some crunch :(
[a l an] Wicked Sauce is disgusting. Super Charge for the win!
[witheredcouch] I haven't tried wicked as I assumed it would just be a slightly hotter Super Charged, which for me tastes not spicy, but just like chemicals.
[Dollar Dreamer] It's way over priced. Don't do it, used to be $3.20 in 2006, 20 years ago.
[Fuzor] That sauce they include is priced at $3.5 each so you're essentially paying $9.5 for the food
[BewareOfThe Dog] I still have the 6pc for 9.95 in my promos. ;)
[Phoebus] Gourmet dinner for two, $12.95. Who's complaining about inflation? Go on, spoil her.
[hippyhippy] I hate kfc nugget deals cause their nuggets are the worse… give us deals on anything else
[Phoebus] Mcd nuggets are shit too.
Are HJs the best?
[SpainKing] Used to be, way back when they were finger shaped and the batter had visible black pepper. Hope whichever executive decided on the change had an upsetting week and their penis shrunk at least 3 sizes
[adventurer] I agree with you KFC nuggets are shit now. More fillers than chicken.
[BewareOfThe Dog] Red rooster cheesy nuggets. Are the best, but decent pieces, tenders preferred.
[Brisbane1] I think Xmas in July was enough for me tummy is already out by 5cms :)
[Brisbane1] Okay with blood pressure but not with diabetic :)
[adventurer] I lost weight in July.
KFC not feeding me enough proper real chicken.
[ATTS] Is teh wicked sauce similars to the supercharged sauce?
[lonewolf] That sauce is crazily priced, when i got it last time during the wicked deal, I thought it would be much larger considering they charge 3.50 for it. But its quite small. Like i cant believe they get away with charging that much for that size. At most it should be $1.
[adventurer] The texture and taste is like 10% chicken.
God knows what are the rest 90% mince card board, dough, lots of air,…….
